digest.component_or_area: Plan-review T10 overlay-infrastructure rubric and criterion evaluation
propositions: T10 rubric must partition durable infrastructure from transient de-risk experiments while retaining all four MAJOR safety classes (destructive-apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, endpoint-auth) in a scope clause and co-located safety qualifier.

The packaged plan-review-T10.eval.yaml spec must contain exactly ten balanced dataset cases: five pass cases (throwaway loopback probe, fully specified durable, private-network transient with scoped IAM, secret-manager transient, sandboxed teardown) and five finding cases (under-specified lifecycle, destructive transient apply, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext-secret, untrusted-network transient service).
Offline text-contract tests must validate the exact scope clause, exact four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier immediately after, and T10 independence (no T15 or cross-overlay references).
T10 rubric must not assign scope to or name any other overlay criterion, remaining independent.
